lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular clusters arranged in a grid-like formation posterior to the gill region, with approximately 4-6 spots per vertical column in the mid-flank section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of spots; primary high-luminance blobs are centered at these intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient from a light upper edge to a shadowed lower edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant diagonal white linear feature, consistent with a healed scar, crosses the mid-lateral flank, extending from an anterior-dorsal to a posterior-ventral position.
